title: Job Openings for Fresh Graduates and Impact of Decline in Firms' Intention to Hire
what_it_is: Job Openings for Fresh Graduates and Impact of Decline in Firms' Intention to Hire

sections.label: Fresh graduate employment rates
sections.summary: About 90% of the 2022 fresh graduate cohort were employed within six months, with 80% of those in full-time permanent employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Amongst fresh graduates who were looking for jobs, about 90% of the 2022 cohort were employed within six months of graduation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Of those employed, 80% were in full-time permanent employment, which is comparable to pre-COVID levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The remaining 20% in part-time temporary or freelance employment were mostly in such jobs by choice, with the majority doing so to pursue further studies.

sections.label: Job vacancies and ratio
sections.summary: Job vacancies trended downwards but remained high at 87,900 as at June 2023, with a ratio of 1.94 to unemployed persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The number of job vacancies has trended downwards but remained high at 87,900 as at June 2023 and the ratio of job vacancies to unemployed persons stood at 1.94.

sections.label: Fresh graduate under-employment rate
sections.summary: Time-related under-employment among fresh graduates is 1.9% today.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For fresh graduates, it is way below that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It is 1.9% of fresh graduates today that have time-related under-employment.

sections.label: ICT sector training programmes
sections.summary: IMDA runs the TechSkills Accelerator for ITE and Polytechnics Alliance set up in 2022, and MOE is scaling up Work-Study programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In the information and communications technology sector, we work with the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA).

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There is a TechSkills Accelerator programme for ITE and polytechnics called the TechSkills Accelerator for ITE and Polytechnics Alliance; and this was set up in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Additionally, the Ministry of Education (MOE) is also scaling up Work-Study programmes where fresh polytechnic and ITE graduates are placed into jobs where they can deepen their skills through a structured training programme that includes on-the-job training while they are pursuing careers which are related to the discipline of study.

sections.label: Labour Market Report release
sections.summary: A subsequent Parliamentary Question can be filed, and the Labour Market Report will be released in December.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Perhaps Mr Leong can file a subsequent Parliamentary Question on this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are going to release the Labour Market Report in December.
